technical.zh-CN: ROBOTO Origin 标注 23 自由度、约 34kg，开放机械、电气、底层控制及仿真资料，支持 ROS 2 和 OTA；RP1 则支持热插拔换电与可选头部方案。
technical.en: ROBOTO Origin is listed with 23 degrees of freedom and about 34kg; mechanical, electrical, low-level control and simulation resources are described as open, with ROS 2 and OTA support. RP1 supports hot-swappable batteries and optional head configurations.
